title: Added more direction support to our one-shot tool
author: Kaninen_Ka9en

comments.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
comments.body:
Added a new tool that lets you one-shot pixel art characters with rotations and animations :) [video of the tool in action](https://youtu.be/RISPOYqeEGo)

If you are interested in checking it out, there is a free trial that allows you to generate images and rotations and you get more generations every day. [Link to the project](http://www.pixellab.ai/)

replies.author: gremblinz
replies.body: Does this tool actually adhere its outputs to a uniform pixel grid? The biggest problem I’ve seen with AI pixel art is the pixels are inconsistently sized, if this solved that I’d love to use it
